sustituciones.ASUNTO: Comunicación de no aceptación te: SUBJECT: Temporary non-acceptance and continued waiting list status of a case referred to the Family Treatment Team (ETF).
sustituciones.De conformidad con lo establecido en el: Under section 6.3 of the Manual for the Family Treatment Programme for Children at Risk or in Need of Protection (ETF Manual), the Team’s current organisational circumstances and available resources mean that it cannot immediately accept this case into the Family Treatment Programme (PTF).
sustituciones.En consecuencia, el expediente permanece: The case will therefore remain on the waiting list until the Family Treatment Team has the resources and capacity to provide appropriate support.
sustituciones.Asimismo, teniendo en consideración que: Longer waiting times can have an adverse effect on family situations. When demand for support is high and/or there is a waiting list, the order of access to the Risk Subprogramme and/or the Family Reunification Subprogramme will follow the priority criteria in the ETF Manual (pages 66 and 77, respectively), taking account of the circumstances and needs of each case.
sustituciones.Por último, se considera necesario garan: Professional intervention with the family must continue during the waiting period. Until the ETF formalises the Acceptance Record and the family enters the Programme, Community Social Services, through the relevant Social Work Unit (UTS), will remain responsible for the family’s support and follow-up, within their remit and in line with professional judgement.
sustituciones.Todo ello, sin perjuicio de la revisión: The case may be reviewed and accepted by the ETF as soon as possible, in line with the established priority criteria and the specialist service’s available capacity.
sustituciones.Ruego, le hagan llegar esta información: Please pass this information to the Family Treatment Team and the UTS that referred case {{numero}}.
